title: RMTP v0.4 Replication Propagation Envelope
description: Defines externally issued boundaries for multi-generation AI agent replication. The envelope constrains propagation but never grants replication, delegation, deployment, or execution authority.

envelope_id.description: Unique identifier of this propagation envelope.

root_agent_id.description: Root identity of the replication lineage governed by this envelope.

issuer_id.description: External principal issuing the propagation boundary. Actual issuer authority must be independently verified.

authority_ref.description: Reference to an applicable external authority record. This reference does not establish delegation or execution permission.

allowed_scope.description: Scopes within which propagation proposals may be evaluated.

max_depth.description: Maximum permitted generation depth measured from the root at depth zero. A value of zero prohibits descendants.

max_total_descendants.description: Maximum number of distinct descendant identities admitted during the envelope's lifetime. Retired descendants remain counted.

max_active_descendants.description: Maximum number of concurrently active descendant slots under the envelope. Unverified retirement does not release an active slot.

valid_from.description: Start of the propagation boundary's validity interval.

valid_until.description: Exclusive end of the propagation boundary's validity interval.

revocation_status.description: Declared envelope status. Unknown or non-active status cannot support a new PASS propagation decision.

verification_reference.description: Evidence reference used to authenticate the envelope. Synthetic test references do not establish production trust.

verification_ref.description: Reference to the independent verification assessment.

issued_at.description: Timestamp at which the envelope was issued.

parent_envelope_ref.description: Optional reference to a more restrictive parent envelope. It does not itself establish authority delegation.

budget_ledger_ref.description: Optional reference to a shared replication budget ledger.

execution_authorized.description: A propagation envelope never grants execution authority.
